name: loopd-mod-pane
displayName: loopd — pane (a mod that draws the board inside the session)
description: COMPANION, a mod. /board opens a pane beside the session. In operator mode (the default) it draws the board — in-flight tasks, the need-you rail, per-project counts — from .loopd/SNAPSHOT.json, with Tick (/loopd:dispatch) and Refresh. In simple mode it draws per project a done/total bar, each open question with its options, a text field and More, and each blocked task as one sentence, read from the task documents; every answer runs /loopd:answer. No model call, no permission decision, no process, no network, no write. Not installed = the three core renderers are all there is.

mode.title: Pane mode
mode.description: operator draws the full board from the snapshot; simple draws only projects, open questions and blocked tasks, from the task documents.
